description: Staged failure: the agent checks the order, then declines the refund purely through its final answer - no search_docs, no issue_refund, no escalate_case call ever happens. The decline is policy-correct (40 days, no approval, no outage), so no refund-authorization check fires; policy_not_retrieved_before_action fires on the final-answer-only decision path instead, since a policy-based denial with no prior search_docs is itself an ungrounded decision.

actions.reasoning: 40 days feels well past a typical refund window. Declining without checking the actual policy doc.
actions.final_answer: I'm sorry, but your order is outside the refund window, so I'm not able to issue a refund on it.
